jobs.name: weekly-trust-rerank
jobs.prompt: Run the weekly fact_store trust re-ranking so the harness compounds memory from usage. Steps: 1) Dry-run and report top movers: python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/trust_rerank.py --limit 8 (read output). 2) Apply the re-rank: python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/trust_rerank.py --apply. 3) Briefly report (a) how many facts had usage signal, (b) the top 3 trust movers, (c) confirm apply succeeded. Do NOT touch any facts with retrieval_count=0. This is a local-only self-improvement job — just summarize the result in the final response.

jobs.name: Weekly Security Audit — LUNAV, R-Tessera, CDM
jobs.prompt:
You are Neo, CEO of the Hermes agent team. Every Monday, coordinate a full security audit of all three production systems.

## Team
- **Max** — Technical expert, audits LUNAV Solutions + CDM
- **Lisa** — Technical expert, audits R-Tessera
- **Neo (you)** — CEO, consolidates findings and reports to MARU

## Task
1. Create a kanban board called 'security-audit-YYYY-MM-DD' (use today's date)
2. Create 3 audit tasks:
   - 'LUNAV Solutions — Full Security Audit' assigned to max. Audit live at lunavsolution.vercel.app. Standards: OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS, NIST CSF. Areas: auth/session, authorization/RLS, input validation, security headers, API security, data protection, dependencies, error handling. Deliverable: ranked findings (Critical/High/Medium/Low) with remediation.
   - 'R-Tessera — Full Security Audit' assigned to lisa. Audit live at r-tessera.vercel.app. Same standards and areas.
   - 'CDM — Full Security Audit' assigned to max. Audit CDM Surroundings (local-data only). Same standards and areas.
3. Create a CEO review task assigned to yourself (default) with all 3 audit tasks as parents. Body: 'Consolidate all findings into executive summary, prioritize by risk, present to MARU.'
4. Start the gateway so tasks get picked up: hermes gateway start
5. Log the audit kickoff to team memory: team_memory_add('neo', 'security', 'audit', 'Weekly security audit kicked off for LUNAV, R-Tessera, CDM', 'audit,security,weekly')
6. Report to MARU: 'Weekly security audit started. Max is auditing LUNAV + CDM, Lisa is auditing R-Tessera. Results will be consolidated and presented when complete.'

## Important
- Use hermes kanban boards create, hermes kanban create, hermes gateway start
- The kanban board slug should be kebab-case with today's date
- All tasks must have proper --body, --assignee, --json flags
- The CEO review task must reference all 3 audit tasks as --parent
